From the steady growth in its infratech landscape to its global dominance in mining AI, Australia continues to make significant progress in positioning itself as a strong competitor among the innovation ecosystems of the Asia-Pacific region, writes Alberto Onetti, chairman of Mind the Bridge, who shares the findings of the recent Scaleup Summit Australia.
